author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Cultural Transmission - Inherited Team Formation Bias
abstract: This submission initiates research into 'Cultural Transmission of Strategies.' It builds upon the successful 'Predictive Team Formation Game' (Eval ID: 311). At the halfway point of the simulation, a subset of agents is replaced by 'new generation' agents. These new agents are initialized with a bias in their team choice and signaling strategies, derived from the average learned strategies of the preceding generation. The experiment uses decaying epsilon-greedy exploration and aims to determine if this inherited bias accelerates learning and maintains self-organization, optimizing for sustained collective reward compared to starting from scratch.
